周日的王府井非常热闹，外面是人挤人，里面也是人挤人。
刘济民一家三口，在门口挤了好一会儿，才走进了王府井里面。
王府井一楼最为热闹，因为卖的都是一些家常日用品，如雪花膏、香皂、糖果之类的东西。这些东西相对价格低，能消费得起的人多。
家长抱着小孩子排在糖果柜台前，小孩子馋得哇哇乱叫，口水把家长胸前的衣服打湿一大片。
有的家长实在是哄不住了，直接撩起衣服就开始哄孩子。
看到这一幕，刘济民老脸一红，赶紧将目光挪到其他地方。
王爱梅和刘振国身处热闹的商场，非但不感觉到吵闹，反而一脸高兴，越挤好像越兴奋。
两人对商场里的所有商品都感觉到好奇，哪怕是家里有的东西，也要多看两眼。不过好在没有忘记逛商场的主要任务，半个小时后终于走到了电风扇柜台。
家用电器的柜台前人相对较少，电风扇这儿只有五六个人。
等轮到他们后，刘济民指着里面的立式“华生牌”落地扇问道：“华生牌的多少钱？”
“这个立式一米三的，104块钱，华生的，耐用。”
刘振国指着旁边的台扇问道：“这种的多少钱？”
“这个便宜，五十三块钱，风没有这个大。”
华生是中国第一家电风扇制造公司，一直是质量的象征。
质量好到什么程度？你甚至可以在四十年后还能看到它在某些老同志家“嘎吱嘎吱”的转。
刘振国看了一眼王爱梅，露出了征询的目光，老刘同志很明白谁才是最后拍板的人。
王爱梅上前一步，思考了片刻，问刘济民道：“要不买落地扇吧，贵是贵了点，但以后省得换，能用好长时间。”
“妈，我也是这个意思。”刘济民爽快地掏出了风扇票，接着又去收银柜台付钱，再拿着票据回来扛风扇。
刘振国扛着风扇跟扛着肩扛式防空导弹似的，走到哪里都得大声喊着“让一让！”
又花了五十块钱买了台牡丹牌半导体收音机，王爱梅抱着爱不释手。
临走前还专门问柜员哪个频道能听豫剧，柜员翻了一个白眼说“再见了您嘞！”
一人抱着收音机，一人扛着电风扇，刘济民走在中间，搞得像是左右护法，回头率超过了百分之二百。

Wangfujing is very lively on Sundays. It’s crowded outside and crowded inside.
Liu Jimin's family of three crowded at the door for a long time before entering Wangfujing.
The first floor of Wangfujing is the busiest, because it sells some daily necessities, such as cream, soap, candies and the like. These things are relatively cheap and many people can afford them.
Parents were lining up in front of the candy counter with their children in their arms. The children were so greedy that they screamed and drooled all over the clothes on the parents' chests.
Some parents really couldn't coax them anymore, so they just lifted up their clothes and started coaxing their children.
Seeing this scene, Liu Jimin blushed and quickly looked elsewhere.
Wang Aimei and Liu Zhenguo were in a busy shopping mall. Instead of feeling noisy, they looked happy. The more crowded they became, the more excited they seemed.
The two of them were curious about all the products in the mall, even if they were things they had at home, they had to take a second look. Fortunately, I didn't forget the main task of visiting the mall. After half an hour, I finally reached the electric fan counter.
There are relatively few people in front of the counter of household appliances, and there are only five or six people in front of the electric fan.
When it was their turn, Liu Jimin pointed to the vertical "Watson" floor fan inside and asked, "How much does the Watson brand cost?"
"This vertical one, 1.3 meters, costs 104 yuan. It's from Watson. It's durable."
Liu Zhenguo pointed to the table fan next to him and asked, "How much does this kind of thing cost?"
"This one is cheap, fifty-three yuan, and the wind is not as big as this one."
Watson is the first electric fan manufacturing company in China and has always been a symbol of quality.
How good is the quality? You can even see it "crunching" in the homes of some old comrades forty years later.
Liu Zhenguo glanced at Wang Aimei with a questioning look. Old Comrade Liu knew very well who had the final say.
Wang Aimei stepped forward, thought for a moment, and asked Liu Jimin: "Why don't you buy a floor fan? It's a bit expensive, but you won't have to replace it in the future and it can be used for a long time."
"Mom, that's what I mean." Liu Jimin readily took out the ticket for the fan, then went to the cashier counter to pay, and then came back with the ticket to carry the fan.
Liu Zhenguo carried the fan like a shoulder-fired anti-aircraft missile. He had to shout "Give way!" wherever he went.
She spent another fifty yuan to buy a Peony brand semiconductor radio, and Wang Aimei couldn't put it down.
Before leaving, I asked the teller which channel I could listen to Henan Opera. The teller rolled his eyes and said, "Goodbye!"
One person was holding a radio, and the other was carrying an electric fan. Liu Jimin walked in the middle, acting like a guardian on the left and right, with a turnaround rate of more than 200%.
